## Description

## Related Issues/PRs

If applicable, please link to related issue(s) or PRs here (e.g. `#123`), including PRs in the companion repositories (sceptre-phenix-apps, sceptre-phenix-images, sceptre-phenix) that this change needs.

## Type of Change

Please select the type of change your pull request introduces:

- [ ] Test (`test`)
- [ ] Chore (CI, build, dependencies, generated files, etc.) (`chore`, `ci`)
